summary.en: Chiesi focuses on respiratory disease, rare disorders and neonatology. Selected investigational programs combine partnered Phase 3 respiratory and neonatal assets with earlier fibrosis research.
summary.zh: Chiesi 专注于呼吸系统疾病、罕见病和新生儿学。部分在研项目将合作的 III 期呼吸和新生儿资产与较早期的纤维化研究相结合。

ind.zh: 支气管扩张症(中国以外)

target.zh: 中性粒细胞弹性蛋白酶

ind.zh: 预防支气管肺发育不良

watch.en: Respiratory sales were EUR1.886 billion in 2025, versus EUR3.625 billion of group revenue.
watch.zh: 2025 年呼吸系统产品销售额为 EUR1.886 billion,集团收入为 EUR3.625 billion。

watch.en: HSK31858 was licensed from Haisco for development and commercialization outside Greater China.
watch.zh: HSK31858 从 Haisco 授权引进,用于大中华区以外的开发和商业化。

watch.en: 2025 R&D spending was EUR885 million, with a positive EUR729 million net financial position.
watch.zh: 2025 年研发支出为 EUR885 million,净财务状况为正 EUR729 million。

watch.en: The pipeline lists Phase 3 carbon-minimal inhaler formulations, but these are excluded as reformulations of approved medicines.
watch.zh: 管线列出了 III 期低碳吸入剂配方,但因属于已获批药物的重新配方而不计入。
